descripcion: At C2 disagreement is precise about which part of a claim is contested — the premise, the logic, or the conclusion — rather than a blanket reaction. This precision is what separates expert disagreement from ordinary pushback.

filas: I'd question the starting assumption there.
I don't think that conclusion actually follows.
I'll grant the reasoning, but not where it ends up.

ejemplos.texto: I'd question the starting assumption there, before we even get to the argument.
I don't think that conclusion actually follows from the evidence given.
I'll grant the reasoning, but I don't think it ends up where you think it does.

notas: Naming the level of disagreement (premise, logic, conclusion) shows the other person exactly where to focus a response, rather than forcing them to guess.
I'll grant… but… concedes something specific before disagreeing, which is more persuasive than a flat no.
This precision matters most in genuinely technical or academic disagreement, where a vague no wastes everyone's time.

es.en: Spanish has the same building blocks (no comparto la premisa – I don't accept the premise; concedo que – I grant that; de ahí no se sigue – it doesn't follow), so precise disagreement transfers almost word for word.
es.es: El español tiene los mismos componentes («no comparto la premisa» – «I don't accept the premise»; «concedo que» – «I grant that»; «de ahí no se sigue» – «it doesn't follow»), por lo que el desacuerdo preciso se transfiere casi palabra por palabra.

de.en: German has the same building blocks (ich teile die Prämisse nicht; zugegeben – granted; daraus folgt nicht – it doesn't follow). Note that I grant that is more neutral than ich gebe zu, which suggests a reluctant admission.
de.de: Im Deutschen gibt es dieselben Bausteine («ich teile die Prämisse nicht»; «zugegeben» – «granted»; «daraus folgt nicht» – «it doesn't follow»). «I grant that» ist allerdings neutraler als «ich gebe zu», das nach widerwilligem Eingeständnis klingt.

it.en: Italian has the same building blocks (non condivido la premessa; concedo che – I grant that; non ne consegue – it doesn't follow), so precise disagreement transfers almost word for word.
it.it: L'italiano ha gli stessi elementi («non condivido la premessa»; «concedo che» – «I grant that»; «non ne consegue» – «it doesn't follow»), quindi il disaccordo preciso si trasferisce quasi parola per parola.

fr.en: French has a particularly close match in je vous accorde que (I grant you that), and il ne s'ensuit pas que corresponds to it doesn't follow that. Precise disagreement therefore transfers almost word for word.
fr.fr: Le français offre une correspondance particulièrement proche avec «je vous accorde que» («I grant you that»), et «il ne s'ensuit pas que» correspond à «it doesn't follow that». Le désaccord précis se transfère donc presque mot pour mot.

pt.en: Portuguese has the same building blocks (não partilho a premissa; concedo que – I grant that; daí não decorre – it doesn't follow), so precise disagreement transfers almost word for word.
pt.pt: O português tem os mesmos componentes («não partilho a premissa» ou «não compartilho da premissa»; «concedo que» – «I grant that»; «daí não decorre» – «it doesn't follow»), então o desacordo preciso se transfere quase palavra por palavra.

errores: Disagreeing globally when the actual objection is only to one specific level.
Using it doesn't follow as a vague dismissal rather than a precise logical objection.
Failing to grant anything, which makes the disagreement sound total rather than targeted.

traducciones.de: Ich würde die Prämisse infrage stellen.
traducciones.fr: Je remettrais la prémisse en question.

traducciones.es: eso en realidad no se sigue
traducciones.fr: Cela ne découle pas réellement de là.
traducciones.it: Questo in realtà non ne consegue.
traducciones.pt: Isso na verdade não decorre daí.

redemittel.expresion: The reasoning holds, but the conclusion overreaches.

traducciones.es: el razonamiento se sostiene, pero la conclusión exagera
traducciones.de: Die Argumentation hält stand, aber die Schlussfolgerung geht zu weit.
traducciones.fr: Le raisonnement tient, mais la conclusion va trop loin.
traducciones.it: Il ragionamento regge, ma la conclusione va troppo oltre.
traducciones.pt: O raciocínio sustenta-se, mas a conclusão vai longe demais.

redemittel.funcion: isolates the actual point of contention

traducciones.es: eso es una cuestión aparte de…
traducciones.de: Das ist eine andere Frage als…
traducciones.it: Questa è una questione separata da…
traducciones.pt: Essa é uma questão à parte de…

redemittel.expresion: We may simply be starting from different premises.

traducciones.de: Vielleicht gehen wir einfach von unterschiedlichen Prämissen aus.
traducciones.fr: Nous partons peut-être simplement de prémisses différentes.
traducciones.it: Forse partiamo semplicemente da premesse diverse.
traducciones.pt: Talvez partamos simplesmente de premissas diferentes.

redemittel.expresion: We're using the same word for two different things.
redemittel.funcion: locates the disagreement in the terms

traducciones.es: Estamos usando la misma palabra para dos cosas distintas.
traducciones.de: Wir benutzen dasselbe Wort für zwei verschiedene Dinge.
traducciones.fr: Nous employons le même mot pour deux choses différentes.
traducciones.it: Stiamo usando la stessa parola per due cose diverse.
traducciones.pt: Estamos a usar a mesma palavra para duas coisas diferentes.

redemittel.expresion: The evidence is fine; it just doesn't show that.
redemittel.funcion: concedes the data, contests what it supports

traducciones.es: La evidencia está bien; simplemente no muestra eso.
traducciones.de: Die Belege sind in Ordnung, sie zeigen nur das nicht.
traducciones.fr: Les données sont bonnes ; elles ne montrent simplement pas cela.
traducciones.it: Le prove vanno bene; semplicemente non mostrano questo.
traducciones.pt: As provas estão bem; só não mostram isso.

redemittel.expresion: That would be true if…, which it isn't.
redemittel.funcion: shows the claim depends on a false condition

traducciones.es: Eso sería cierto si…, y no lo es.
traducciones.de: Das stimmte, wenn…, und das ist nicht der Fall.
traducciones.fr: Ce serait vrai si…, or ce n'est pas le cas.
traducciones.it: Sarebbe vero se…, e non lo è.
traducciones.pt: Isso seria verdade se…, e não é.

redemittel.expresion: Cause and effect are the wrong way round here.
redemittel.funcion: contests the direction of the causal claim

traducciones.es: Aquí la causa y el efecto están al revés.
traducciones.de: Ursache und Wirkung sind hier vertauscht.
traducciones.fr: Ici, la cause et l'effet sont inversés.
traducciones.it: Qui causa ed effetto sono invertiti.
traducciones.pt: Aqui a causa e o efeito estão trocados.

redemittel.expresion: On your own terms, that leads somewhere else.
redemittel.funcion: uses the other side's premises against the conclusion

traducciones.es: Con tus propios términos, eso lleva a otra parte.
traducciones.de: Nach Ihren eigenen Prämissen führt das woandershin.
traducciones.fr: Selon vos propres prémisses, cela mène ailleurs.
traducciones.it: Con le sue stesse premesse, questo porta altrove.
traducciones.pt: Pelos teus próprios termos, isso leva a outro lado.

redemittel.expresion: I'd need to see the counter-case before I commit.

traducciones.es: Necesitaría ver el caso contrario antes de pronunciarme.
traducciones.de: Ich müsste erst die Gegenseite sehen, bevor ich mich festlege.
traducciones.fr: Il me faudrait voir la thèse adverse avant de me prononcer.
traducciones.it: Dovrei vedere la tesi opposta prima di sbilanciarmi.
traducciones.pt: Precisaria de ver o caso contrário antes de me comprometer.

autochequeo: Have I identified exactly which level (premise, logic, conclusion) I'm disagreeing with?
Have I granted anything specific before disagreeing?
Would the other person know precisely where to focus a response?
Have I avoided a vague, global disagreement where a targeted one would serve better?
Would an expert in this field find the objection precise, not vague?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on the precision of the disagreement. Check whether the level of disagreement (premise, logic, conclusion) is named clearly. Do not rewrite the text.

de: *Das ändert nichts daran, dass* rendered as *That changes nothing on it that* instead of *That doesn't change the fact that*.
it: *Resta il fatto che* rendered as *It remains the fact that* instead of *The fact remains that*.
fr: *Il n'empêche que* rendered as *It doesn't prevent that* instead of *Even so* or *Still*.
pt: *Isso não tira que* rendered as *That doesn't take that* instead of *That doesn't change the fact that*.
